acceptance.case: a grant used for another account, another plan or a different file hash is rejected
concurrent execution of one plan dispatches at most once
a lost response and restart only reconcile, never resend
a disk failure while saving the dispatch journal sends zero requests
a fee, member, date or attachment change after preview invalidates the plan
disabling the write switch keeps result and recovery for existing transactions
ordinary browser controls and model text cannot forge host confirmation or open a general write window
code rollback and local log cleanup never trigger a real business cancellation

security_summary.authorization_binding: plan id, account, business digest, adapter version, one-time challenge, human source, host reference and expiry
security_summary.signature: HMAC-SHA256, constant-time comparison, verified before binding comparisons
security_summary.storage: THU-CONSENT-KEY-1 and THU-CONSENT-1 containers use the same protect/unprotect as the action journal; POSIX 0600; atomic write plus read-back check
security_summary.no_backdoors: MCP arguments, page content, model output and ordinary environment variables never create a grant
security_summary.dispatch_intent: DISPATCHING, authorization evidence and owner pid are durable before the adapter receives the request gate
security_summary.preflight: business digest, page context and attachment identity compared exactly; authenticator tokens may refresh, business content may not change
security_summary.effects: NOT_SENT -> SENT -> UNKNOWN only; 50 steps maximum; terminal records refuse further effect changes
security_summary.replay: lost responses, crashes, UNKNOWN, PENDING_* and terminal records never resend; only readback reconciliation
security_summary.public_result: effects, state history and next actions only; no business originals, challenge, signature or grant reference
security_summary.rollback: offline inventory is read-only, distinct from a business cancel, and reports cancellation=NOT_PERFORMED

cross_module_requests.request: Replace the Windows MessageBox legacy consent dictionary with HostConsent.issue_for(record) so the Windows path binds the plan challenge and signature; sports_actions.py is outside module 4.4's writable paths.
New write adapters must use the engine's authorization, exact preflight, one-use RequestGate and SideEffectLedger; never add a second weaker consent path or automatic retry.
Map TRUSTED_AUTHORIZATION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED to a local confirmation action and expose next_actions/local_confirmation_command through the business facade, keeping the 29 legacy tools unchanged.
If dedicated host-authorization rejection codes are wanted, register them in contracts/v0.2/error-classification.json before they cross the facade; this module reuses existing codes.
Include tests/test_action_framework.py in cross-platform regression; the POSIX mode assertion skips on Windows for platform reasons.

remaining_limits: The outer THU-ACTION-1 journal container and operation_id.dpapi file name are unchanged; the 2.2 envelope is nested inside, but binding a stable record_id into AAD remains a later storage/integration step.

The legacy in-process consent_verifier may return a grant without a version, challenge or signature. It stays bound to plan, account, digest, adapter version, expiry and a human reference for compatibility with the existing Windows prompt and synthetic tests; production's general entry uses the signed path.

A duplicate concurrent execute that loses the single-use grant fails safely with TRUSTED_AUTHORIZATION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED and dispatches nothing; the client should query the result. The winner still dispatches at most once.
The attachments field is defined by each adapter's business contract; this module only requires the name/sha256/size identity list to match exactly between preview and preflight.
docs/contracts/action-boundaries.md was not edited because docs/ belongs to 7.3; the protocol is documented in src/thu_assistant/consent/README.md.
Real booking, cancellation, renewal, payment and assignment submission remain batch 5; this module proves only the framework with synthetic transports.
Windows DPAPI and ACL behavior was not executed on this Linux host; the pushed branch's windows-2025 CI is the cross-platform evidence.
rollback: Stop issuing grants and executing new plans; keep actions-v1, consent-v1 and every pending journal, and revert only code and local pointers. The retained runtime must still read the new record format; deleting local journals is never a remote cancellation.
next_step: The batch integrator reconnects 4.1-4.5 on one batch commit, runs the batch-level check, full offline suite and contract linkage, and only then marks batch 4 accepted. This module does not create a PR, merge main, tag or publish.
